title: Discovery of novel murine PML isoforms.
authors: Anderova, Karolina; Hornikova, Lenka; Sroller, Vojtech; Ryabchenko, Boris; Panek, Dalibor; Andrikopoulos, Prokopis C; Zahradnik, Jiri; Forstova, Jitka; Huerfano, Sandra
one_liner_zh: 该文发现小鼠PML新亚型并利用分子动力学模拟分析其构象稳定性，但核心是PML蛋白亚型功能，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，仅MD方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Promyelocytic leukemia protein (PML) orchestrates the formation of PML nuclear bodies (PML NBs), membraneless organelles with diverse regulatory roles. Despite their importance, the specific functions of individual PML splicing variants remain unclear, particularly in murine models. Here we study the repertoire of murine PML isoforms expressed in mouse tissues and cells. We demonstrate that in addition to canonical mPML1-3, mice express five predicted variants (mPMLX1, mPMLX2, mPMLX4-X6) and a novel isoform, mPMLX7, distinguished by unique RBCC domain splicing. All isoforms exhibit distinct turnover kinetics at endogenous PML NBs. In PML-knockout cells, all isoforms except mPMLX7 form NBs de novo and are degraded upon arsenic exposure. Molecular dynamics simulations suggest mPMLX7 adopts a stable conformation; furthermore, this isoform is enriched in the nucleoplasm, suggesting a specialized function. Altogether, this isoform-resolved PML system provides a relevant model for dissecting the wide spectrum of PML-associated processes.
abstract_zh: 早幼粒细胞白血病蛋白（PML）协调PML核体（PML NBs）的形成，这些无膜细胞器具有多种调控功能。尽管它们的重要性，个体PML剪接变体的具体功能仍不清楚，尤其是在小鼠模型中。在此，我们研究小鼠组织和细胞中表达的鼠源PML异构体谱系。我们证明，除了经典的mPML1-3外，小鼠还表达五种预测变体（mPMLX1、mPMLX2、mPMLX4-X6）以及一种新型异构体mPMLX7，其通过独特的RBCC结构域剪接加以区分。所有异构体在内源性PML NBs处表现出不同的周转动力学。在PML敲除细胞中，除mPMLX7外的所有异构体均从头形成NBs，并在砷暴露后降解。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟表明mPMLX7采用稳定构象；此外，该异构体富集于核质中，提示其具有专门功能。总体而言，这种异构体分辨的PML系统为解析PML相关过程的广泛谱系提供了相关模型。
